title: The Plan That Changed on Friday
title_ja: 金曜日に変わった約束
fact_notes: 人物・具体的な出来事は架空の教材例。実在の研究結果や統計を示すものではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: In a fictional story, two friends, Emi and Rosa, planned a weekend visit to an art market.
sentences.ja: ある架空の物語で友人のエミとローザは週末にアート市場を訪れる計画を立てた。

sentences.en: They had discussed the trip for several weeks and reserved their Saturday afternoon for it.
sentences.ja: 数週間その旅行について話し合い土曜日の午後を空けていた。

sentences.en: On Friday, Rosa received an unexpected invitation to join a family celebration at the same time.
sentences.ja: 金曜日、ローザは同じ時刻の家族の祝いに参加する予想外の誘いを受けた。

sentences.en: She immediately sent Emi a message asking whether their meeting could be postponed.
sentences.ja: すぐエミにメッセージを送り会う予定を延期できるか尋ねた。

sentences.en: Emi understood the importance of the family event but felt disappointed by the sudden change.
sentences.ja: エミは家族の行事の重要性を理解したが突然の変更にがっかりした。

sentences.en: She had declined another invitation and completed several tasks early to keep the afternoon available.
sentences.ja: 別の誘いを断り午後を空けるためいくつかの作業を早く終えていた。

sentences.en: Rosa had assumed that changing the date would create little inconvenience because the market opened every weekend.
sentences.ja: 市場は毎週開かれるため日付変更で不便はほとんど生じないと思っていた。

sentences.en: The two friends therefore had different understandings of what the original agreement involved.
sentences.ja: そのため元の約束に何が伴っていたか二人の理解は異なった。

sentences.en: Instead of immediately accepting or rejecting the request, Emi explained the arrangements she had already made.
sentences.ja: すぐに頼みを受け入れたり断ったりせず、エミはすでに行った手配を説明した。

sentences.en: Rosa acknowledged the effort her friend had invested in preparing for their shared plan.
sentences.ja: ローザは共通の計画に向け友人が費やした努力を認めた。

sentences.en: They discussed several alternatives, including a shorter visit before the family celebration.
sentences.ja: 家族の祝いの前に短時間訪問する案など複数の代替案を話し合った。

sentences.en: However, they recognized that trying to include both events might leave too little time for either.
sentences.ja: しかし両方を詰め込むとどちらにも十分な時間がなくなるかもしれないと認識した。

sentences.en: They eventually agreed to reschedule the visit and chose a new date together.
sentences.ja: 最終的に訪問の日程を変更することに合意し新たな日付を一緒に決めた。

sentences.en: Rosa also offered to organize the transportation for their next meeting.
sentences.ja: ローザは次の会合の交通手配も申し出た。

sentences.en: Emi appreciated the gesture because it demonstrated that her earlier preparation had not been ignored.
sentences.ja: 以前の準備が無視されていないことを示す行為としてエミは評価した。

sentences.en: Neither friend treated the new arrangement as a permanent rule governing every future situation.
sentences.ja: どちらも新たな取り決めを今後のすべての状況を規定する恒久的ルールとは見なさなかった。

sentences.en: The experience illustrates that changing a commitment can affect more than the event itself.
sentences.ja: この経験は約束の変更が行事自体以上のものに影響し得ると示す。

sentences.en: People may have devoted time and effort to a plan in ways that are invisible to others.
sentences.ja: 人々は他者には見えない形で計画に時間と努力を費やしている場合がある。

sentences.en: Flexibility becomes easier when those costs are acknowledged and alternatives are discussed honestly.
sentences.ja: その負担が認められ代替案が率直に話し合われると柔軟な対応が容易になる。

sentences.en: Respecting a friendship need not mean keeping every plan unchanged, but it does involve taking each other's commitments seriously.
sentences.ja: 友情を尊重することは全計画を変更しないことではないが互いの約束を真剣に受け止めることを含む。

questions.prompt: What did the friends originally plan?
options: A family dinner at Rosa's house.
A trip to a different country.
A weekend visit to an art market.
questions.explanation_ja: アート市場へ行く計画。

questions.prompt: Why did Rosa request a change?
options: She received a family invitation for the same time.
She wanted to stop seeing Emi.

questions.prompt: Why was Emi disappointed beyond missing the visit?
options: She had already made arrangements to free her time.
She had never wanted to visit the market.
She had forgotten the original date.
questions.explanation_ja: 予定を空けるため努力していた。

options: The market opened only once a year.
Emi had made no plans at all.
A date change would cause little inconvenience.
questions.explanation_ja: 日付変更は大きな不便にならないと思った。

options: A list of Rosa's family members.

questions.prompt: Why did they not simply attend both events?
options: It might leave too little time for either.
They had no transportation at any time.
questions.explanation_ja: どちらも十分な時間が取れないかもしれない。

questions.prompt: What did Rosa offer to do?
Why did Emi appreciate the gesture?
options: It made the original visit unnecessary.
It showed that family events were unimportant.
questions.explanation_ja: 以前の準備を認める行動だった。

options: Family events always matter less than friendships.
Changes to plans can be handled respectfully by acknowledging commitments and discussing alternatives.
A changed date never affects anyone.
questions.explanation_ja: 約束への努力を認め代替案を話し合う。

grammar.focus: whether their meeting could be postponed
grammar.explanation_ja: whether節は尋ねた内容、could be postponedは受動態。

grammar.focus: might leave too little time for either
grammar.explanation_ja: mightは可能性、too littleは不十分な量。

grammar.focus: need not mean keeping every plan unchanged

paraphrases.source: She immediately sent Emi a message asking whether their meeting could be postponed.
paraphrases.rewrite: She asked right away if they could move their meeting to another time.

paraphrases.source: She had declined another invitation and completed several tasks early to keep the afternoon available.
paraphrases.rewrite: She had turned down another invitation and finished work early so that she would be free that afternoon.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 午後を空けるため手配した。

paraphrases.source: However, they recognized that trying to include both events might leave too little time for either.
paraphrases.rewrite: They realized that fitting in both events could mean insufficient time for each one.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 両方の時間が足りない可能性。

paraphrases.source: Respecting a friendship need not mean keeping every plan unchanged, but it does involve taking each other's commitments seriously.
paraphrases.rewrite: Valuing a friendship does not require leaving every arrangement exactly as it was, but commitments should matter.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 友情は変更不可を意味しない。
